items.title: Bitmine adds 12,535 ETH as treasury reaches 6.04 million tokens
items.summary: Bitmine bought 12,535 ETH last week, lifting its treasury to 6.04 million tokens and total investment holdings to $15.1 billion.

items.title: Made an ‘honest’ mistake with crypto taxes? New bill offers way out
items.summary: A proposed US bill would let crypto investors correct past tax reporting mistakes through a dedicated disclosure program, with reduced penalties for eligible taxpayers.

items.title: THORChain Keeps ZEC Swaps Halted After Bug Triggers Vault Slash
items.summary: Onchain records show about 140 RUNE deducted from 18 node accounts.

items.title: Strategy Buys $22M in Bitcoin, Buys Back $193M of STRC
items.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm raised its preferred stock buyback cap to $3 billion and now holds 848,517 BTC, bought at an average of $75,446.
